content.comment_body: Sales and delivery release for firmware [version_no] for [product_name] ([article_no]) and [product_name] ([article_no]) including download. The new firmware [version_no] for these modules has been released and is available for free download. Delivery of the modules with the updated firmware is scheduled to start in 03/2021. 1. Product description Firmware [version_no] replaces [version_no] and introduces extended functions for supporting communication between [product_name] and the new [product_name] [version_no]. The update also provides general improvements and optimizations. Upgrading to [version_no] is required for all users of [product_name] wishing to monitor and control a [product_name] device with the new [version_no]. Due to increased security in [product_name] [version_no], only encrypted connections are permitted between [product_name] modules for data exchange, which is now supported in [version_no] firmware. Additional information regarding simultaneous access from [product_name], [product_name], and [product_name] [version_no], and the new SMS commands can be found in the updated manual. The following improvements are included in firmware [version_no]: • Process Communication: [product_name] can now be started and stopped via the web-based management interface. When stopped, no connections are made or processed. • MSTATUS?: A new SMS type allows retrieval of the current operating status. • MSTATUS=RUN/STOP: A new SMS command can change the operating status via SMS. • ECC (Elliptic Curve Cryptography): ECC encryption has been activated, enabling faster and more secure SSL connections. • SMS Send Correction: Fixed a sporadic SMS send error caused by improper settings when using SIM cards with a PIN on the [product_name]. • GPS: Display error for negative altitudes in the web-based management interface has been corrected. • Compatibility: As of [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no], unrestricted access to user-defined web pages is supported by [product_name] modules. Note: Restrictions mentioned in the referenced FAQ apply only to [product_name] versions lower than [version_no]: [article_no]

analysis.insight_summary: The announcement details the release of firmware [version_no] for the [product_name] series, providing crucial updates for compatibility, security, and usability with the latest [product_name] devices. This upgrade introduces extended SMS commands, enhanced encryption, fixes for minor communication errors, and supports seamless access to user-created web pages when used with the newest [product_name] modules. The improvements focus on resolving past issues with process communication, encryption, and reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect secure, reliable, and fully functional communication between [product_name] modules and the latest [product_name] devices. They look for sustained compatibility through firmware updates, new control and monitoring options like SMS command features, and solutions for previously reported functional and display issues.
